plain: If your CSS reads var(--font-sans) from the Tailwind theme layer, it now resolves to the system UI stack (-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto and others); HDS text keeps its own font tokens.

steps.plain: Tailwind 4.3 changed the default --font-sans in @layer theme to a system UI stack; text that reads var(--font-sans) can render in a different system font.
